tagline: Turn any AI function or API into a paid, verifiable agent service on Stellar in minutes

problem.headline: AI agents can find each other but can't safely pay each other
bullets: Agent directories list self-declared services with no proof the endpoint works or charges fairly
Pay-per-call APIs lose money or double-charge when a response drops mid-flight
Every provider hand-rolls payments, retries and queues, so integrations break in subtle ways
Buyers have no standard way to compare price, schema and trust before they spend
problem.notes: Agent marketplaces are growing fast, but trust and payment are the bottleneck.

solution.headline: One open standard, a kit, and a verifier for paid agent services
bullets: Provider Standard v1 defines manifest, jobs, receipts and error codes as testable rules
Provider Kit wraps a function or existing HTTP API into an x402 USDC paid service
Job Recovery decides uncertain payments from the chain, so nobody pays twice
A verifier issues on-chain receipts and badges through the Stellar 8004 registry

howItWorks.headline: From function to paid service in three steps

steps.title: Define the service
steps.detail: Price, JSON schemas and a handler in a few lines of TypeScript, or a gateway config

steps.title: Publish and register
steps.detail: Serve the manifest over HTTPS and register the provider on Stellar 8004

steps.title: Get paid per job
steps.detail: Agents pay in USDC via x402; results survive restarts and lost responses

steps.title: Earn trust
steps.detail: The verifier checks C1–C7 and records badges in the Validation Registry

architecture.headline: Small, separable packages around a frozen spec

components.name: Protocol
components.role: The standard as code: schemas, vectors, no runtime deps

components.name: Provider Kit
components.role: Manifest, x402 challenge, durable SQLite job queue

components.name: Payment Client
components.role: Approval, spending policy, journal and recovery

components.name: Verifier
components.role: Checks providers, proves payments, publishes receipts

components.name: Dev MCP
components.role: Spec rules and manifest checks for coding agents

items.title: Never charge twice
items.detail: Uncertain payments become payment_uncertain and are settled from on-chain data

items.title: Any language
items.detail: Gateway mode puts an existing Python, Go or Rust API behind x402 with no code

items.title: Fair queuing
items.detail: Capacity is checked before the 402, so buyers never pay for work that can't run

items.title: No keys on servers
items.detail: Providers hold only a public payTo address; the facilitator settles

items.title: Agent-ready docs
items.detail: AGENTS.md, llms.txt and a Claude Code plugin guide coding agents

items.title: Verifiable trust
items.detail: Receipts and badges live on chain, not in a self-declared listing

traction.headline: A paid call works end to end on testnet
bullets: Library and gateway providers settle real testnet USDC through the x402 facilitator
Job Recovery and all seven verifier checks are complete in code with test vectors
Built as phase 2 of Stellar Agent Search, already live on Stellar mainnet

items.value: Charge per call in USDC without building billing, retries or queues
Discover, compare and pay services with spending limits and recovery
List providers whose behavior and payments are verified on chain
